about_short_description.short_description: Customily is an e-commerce platform that allows customers to personalize products online.

product.name: Customily Product Personalizer
product.description: An e-commerce software that enables customers to personalize products online with live previews and various customization tools.

identifier.value: Print File Automation and Fulfillment Integration

product.name: Print File Automation and Fulfillment Integration
product.description: Automatically generates print-ready files for personalized orders and integrates with print-on-demand providers for streamlined fulfillment.

product.name: Design Studio and Personalization Tools
product.description: A design interface that allows creation of customizable product templates with text, image uploads, clipart, maps, and advanced effects.

product.name: Multi-Platform Integration and Store Management
product.description: Enables selling personalized products across multiple e-commerce platforms and marketplaces from a single account with centralized order and asset management.

product.name: Customer Shopping Experience Features
product.description: Provides shoppers with a mobile-optimized, fast, and intuitive personalization interface including real-time product previews and saved sessions.
